card.name: Wiping or covering with a swab or pad
card.fires_on: Small words like "with", "a" or "damp" right after a verb of wiping, swabbing, cleansing or pressing in injection-prep steps. The next word is expected to be an item such as alcohol swab, sterile pad, or dressing.

modes.label: Wipe stopper with
modes.description: "with" after wiping or swabbing a vial stopper or injection site, before "an alcohol swab".
modes.example: • Remove the flip-off cap from the single-dose vial and wipe the stopper<< with>> an alcohol swab.

modes.label: Apply a pad or dressing
modes.description: "a" or "small" before a sterile pad, disinfectant or dressing placed on the site.
modes.example: Immediately upon removal of the needle from the muscle, apply gentle pressure with<< a>> sterile pad to the injection site.

modes.label: Moist covering
modes.description: "damp" in a wound-covering step using a cloth.
modes.example: additional moisture may be provided by covering the lesion with a<< damp>>ened clean cotton cloth
